title: a caption written AFTER the routing flip took the text path for a photo with readable bytes
evidence: 1 caption(s) written AFTER the routing flip (commit f37136e, 2026-09-21 15:19Z) took the TEXT path for a photo whose bytes are readable, so the flip is not taking effect in production; corpus 339 photos / 141 attached, newest attachment 2026-05-28. PostAutomation::GenerateCaption used to branch on photo.image.attached?, and Growth::ContentGenerator#import_photo creates photos path-only, so every production caption was written from the photo's context text: measured 2026-09-21, the text path described 'rain drumming on the windowpane ... chamomile tea' for a render that shows an autumn street scene with a mug, which the vision path described correctly. THE BRANCH WAS FLIPPED 2026-09-21 (commit f37136e): it now routes on CaptionGeneration::ImageEncoder.readable?, so a path-only render with a resolvable file takes the vision path -- verified live on photo 353 (generator='vision', gemma3:4b, caption grounded in the image). So a text caption over readable bytes is the flip FAILING, and the window counts above are context, not the condition: a window in which NO post was created (the GPU held by a co-tenant, no renders) is unproven, not broken, and this check stays silent on it.

DECISION 2026-09-21 (operating agent, route=agent): FLIP the branch so path-only photos reach CaptionGeneration::VisionGenerator -- SEQUENCED AFTER persona-age-read-youthful clears. Rationale: captions are written from context text and are measurably wrong (described rain on a windowpane for an autumn street scene the vision path described correctly), and the measured cost is 15.0s per 1.1MB render on the live caption host. The sequencing IS the decision: a vision model describing a minor-reading render makes the persona problem worse, so the persona must read adult first. In-repo half already landed (f55e8ae); the flip is the one-line branch change in PostAutomation::GenerateCaption.

FLIPPED 2026-09-21 (operating agent). The sequencing condition (the persona's age reading) is satisfied by the persona-age-read-youthful fix: the render prompt now states an adult age and the pre-publish age gate HOLDS any render whose read comes back juvenile, so a vision model describing the image can no longer amplify a minor-reading render. CHANGE: PostAutomation::GenerateCaption branches on CaptionGeneration::ImageEncoder.readable? instead of photo.image.attached?, so path-only renders -- every render the growth harness imports -- reach CaptionGeneration::VisionGenerator; a photo with no readable bytes at all still falls back to the text path. VERIFIED live with no GPU: PostAutomation::GenerateCaption.call(photo 353, a real path-only production render) -> success, generator='vision', model=gemma3:4b, caption grounded in the image (the text path had invented a different scene for it). Specs: 226 examples 0 failures, including a new example pinning path-only + readable file -> vision and a fallback example pinning no-bytes -> text. The probe's own check closes this automatically once a post in the window records generator='vision' -- the next rendered post will.

DECISION 2026-09-21 (operating agent): CLOSED by fixing the CHECK, not the caption path. The caption routing flip (f37136e) is live and verified; what kept this entry open for 41 sightings was the check itself: it fired whenever no post in the window carried a vision caption, which is UNPROVEN whenever no post was created at all (the 4090 has been held by prx-tg-pixel-posttrain-v3 all day, so no renders -> no posts). Fixed in bin/tc_ops.py: the condition is now the flip's OWN evidence -- a post created AFTER CAPTION_VISION_FLIP_LANDED (2026-09-21 15:19Z) whose photo has readable bytes yet took the TEXT path (scheduling_posts.caption_metadata->>'generator'), resolved with the same readability rule as CaptionGeneration::ImageEncoder.readable?. A window with no post in it, and rows from before the flip, are now silent instead of an info alarm. Also fixed a UTC-vs-local trap found while verifying: created_at is a timestamp WITHOUT time zone holding UTC wall-clock, so a bare to_timestamp() boundary shifted 4h and counted post 346 (13:01Z, pre-flip) as post-flip -- now (to_timestamp(...) at time zone 'UTC'). Verified: check_caption_image_grounding() -> None on the live DB, probe reports 0 warn for this key, selftest 246 assertions 0 failures (6 new flip-aware cases + 5 backup cases), record re-owned by the probe (--source probe) so a future re-filing can auto-close instead of accumulating. Residual risk kept visible: a post-flip text caption over readable bytes is now a WARN, which is the real defect.
